$comment: openspec-handoff-workflow config. Installed to <project>/.openspec-handoff/config.json. Edit freely.

ai-hero.howTo: Two-axis review (Standards + Spec) of `git diff {base_ref}...HEAD`. Use the OpenSpec change folder as the Spec source: proposal.md and the spec deltas are the requirements; execution/grill.md, execution/spec.md and execution/tickets/ are implementation context only.

superpowers.howTo: Fill the code-reviewer.md template with DESCRIPTION = the proposal's Why/What Changes, PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS = the spec deltas plus execution/plan-<change>.md, BASE_SHA = {base_ref}, HEAD_SHA = HEAD. Report Critical / Important / Minor.

split.$comment: Warn-only. /split-check at the end of the specs stage counts delta requirements and capabilities (warn above maxRequirements / maxCapabilities). The ~limitLines estimate (code + tests) is checked after planning by /spec-check from the tool's tickets / plan tasks. The real PR diff is not measured by this toolkit.
